gate: GPU_SHORT_TRAJECTORY_V1 - when the CPU + GPU hybrid path (GPU atom forces, CPU kicks / drift) runs 10 and 100 consecutive KDK steps, is every step's state equal to the CPU E2 trajectory endpoint for endpoint, including where and how a domain stop happens? Performance only after correctness.
classification: SHORT TRAJECTORY ONLY (T <= 100) - NOT LONG-TRAJECTORY CORRECTNESS

baseline.this_branch: claude/gpu-short-trajectory-v1 from 5511d9f in the main checkout (no worktree); clean at start
baseline.frozen_untouched: no GPU_FORCE_FEASIBILITY_V1 / GPU_PAIR_VECTOR_V1 / GPU_ONE_STEP_V1 file or evidence and no executor is modified; new files only under experiments/gpu_short_trajectory_v1, docs/active/gpu_short_trajectory_v1, tests/test_gpu_short_trajectory_v1.py and docs/active/GPU_SHORT_TRAJECTORY_V1.md

reference_semantics.trajectory: exactly exact_expression_gate_v1.stream.run (exact=False): F_0 = forces(q_0); for s = 0 .. T-1: p_half = p_s + F_s; q_{s+1} = q_s + p_half * cdt; F_{s+1} = forces(q_{s+1}); p_{s+1} = p_half + F_{s+1}. F_{s+1} of step s is the F used by step s + 1 (force reuse): exactly T + 1 force evaluations for T completed steps
reference_semantics.forces: canonical pairs i < j; d = q_j - q_i; r2 = (d0 d0 + d1 d1) + d2 d2; K.domain(r2) must be PROVEN, else DomainStop at the first such pair; g = G(r2) (rw:R1+R2); t = (H g) d_k; F_j += t; F_i -= t
reference_semantics.domain_stop: stream.run's stop_step = the state index s whose forces(q_s) stopped (0 = the initial force); the stop pair id = the first non-PROVEN canonical pair at q_s; nothing after a stop runs (no kick, no later step)
reference_semantics.measurement: K.decide and K.endpoints_key on (q_T, p_T) only at the final T (stream.run want = {T}): cells, UNDECIDED_AT_PRECISION (decide None) or OUT_OF_RANGE (measuring grid; not physics)
reference_semantics.step_indexing: record of step s (s = 0 .. T-1) = (F_s, p_half, q_{s+1}, F_{s+1}, p_{s+1}); a stop at state k >= 1 leaves step k-1 partial (F_s, p_half, q_k only)

division_of_work: GPU: q -> pairs -> G -> J -> canonical atom reduction -> F (GPU_PAIR_VECTOR_V1 kernels and GPU_ONE_STEP_V1 GpuForceExecutor, unchanged); CPU: kicks and drift with mpmath interval primitives at p (one_step.kick / one_step.drift, unchanged). No momentum / position update on the GPU
executor_persistence: one GpuForceExecutor (CUDA context, uploaded model / constants for p, device buffers for N) for the whole trajectory; inside a trajectory no context creation, no model upload and no allocation (counted per trajectory and checked = 0)

statuses.OK: T steps completed; then the final measurement (cells / UNDECIDED_AT_PRECISION / OUT_OF_RANGE)
statuses.DOMAIN_STOP_VIOLATED / DOMAIN_STOP_UNPRO: physics domain duty: stop state index + first stopping pair id
statuses.REFUSED_DEVICE_WIDTH: a GPU width limit (executor, not physics)
statuses.REFUSED_DEVICE_PRECISION: a p the GPU does not support (refused before launch)
statuses.rule: a REFUSED run is neither exact nor a mismatch nor INVALID: it is counted separately and carries no state

digests.vector_serialization: for an N x 3 interval vector X with label L in {F, P, Q}: the ASCII text L + ':' + N + ':' followed by, for atom a = 0..N-1, component k = 0, 1, 2, end = lower, upper: sign '.' mantissa-hex '.' exponent '.' bitcount of the normalized mpmath mpf of that endpoint (a zero mantissa written 0.0.0.0), items joined by ','; digest = sha256 hex of that text
digests.per_step: F_s, p_half (label P), q1 (Q), F1 (F), p1 (P), state = sha256(text(Q, q1) + '|' + text(P, p1)), force = digest of F1
digests.who_computes: the sampler (bundle), the runner and the checker each implement this rule separately; the checker also recomputes the digests of every full state the runner recorded
digests.full_endpoints: full (q_s, p_s, F_s) in G0 dyadic encoding at state indices T = 10: 0, 1, 2, 5, 10; T = 100: 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100 (relative to the trajectory start); and at the first step whose digests differ from the bundle's CPU digests the runner dumps all five vectors of that step

main_trajectories.tie: replica to T = 1000 equals the verified V2 Vast reference N12_T1000__p163

main_trajectories.start: state 500 of the same replica run
state 500 of the same replica run

main_trajectories.tie: no verified reference exists; the replica of the unchanged stream.run source is the CPU reference and the checker recomputes it

bundle.replica: a runtime replica of stream.run (its own source + TWO observer lines: after the drift (q_{s+1}, p_half, F_s) and after the second kick (q_{s+1}, p_{s+1}, F_{s+1})); no file is changed; per-step digests for steps 0..99 from the start, full states at the checkpoint indices, decide / endpoints_key at relative T = 10 and 100

probes (T = 10, both p = 109 and 163).P3_F0_VIOLATED: N = 3: atoms (0,0,0), (1,0,0), (0,20,0) at rest: stop at state 0
probes (T = 10, both p = 109 and 163).P3_MULTI_VIOLATED: N = 3: atom 1 at (6,0,0) with momentum (-m,0,0); m = the first of 0, 50, 100, ... giving a VIOLATED stop at a state index 4..7
probes (T = 10, both p = 109 and 163).P3_MULTI_UNPROVEN: as above with atom 1 at x = [6, 6.5] (an interval position); first m giving an UNPROVEN stop at state 4..7
probes (T = 10, both p = 109 and 163).N12_MULTI_PAIR: FCC_N N = 12 initial state; atom i = 3 and j = the smallest j > 3 that is a nearest neighbour of 3; p_j += m (site_i - site_j) (exact integers); first m of 0, 5, 10, ... giving any stop at state 4..7 with a stop pair id != 0
probes (T = 10, both p = 109 and 163).outcome: the CPU outcome (stop state index, kind, first pair id) recorded by the replica / sampler; per-step digests up to the stop

bundle.seal: the bundle (sha256 committed) is built and committed before any trajectory runner code exists

gates.S10: every main trajectory T = 10 with blocks 32, 64, 128, 256 (grid = ceil) + every probe (block 32) + one refusal run (p = 100, REFUSED_DEVICE_PRECISION); the independent checker must give EVIDENCE OK before anything longer runs
gates.S100: only if S10 passed: every main trajectory T = 100 with block 32; the checker again (S100's first 10 steps must also equal S10's)

checks_per_step: F_s, p_half, q_{s+1}, F_{s+1}, p_{s+1} digests equal the checker's own literal CPU trajectory (every atom x 3 x both ends through the digest) AND the bundle's replica digests; step indices contiguous 0..completed-1; force evaluations = completed + 1 (or stop state + 1); no upload / allocation inside the trajectory; full states at the checkpoint indices equal endpoint for endpoint; the recorded digests equal the checker's recomputation from the recorded full states; final decide and endpoints_key equal; stop (state index, pair, kind) equal; nothing recorded after a stop
first_divergence: for any run with a mismatch the checker reports the first (step, stage in F_s / p_half / q1 / F1 / p1) and, from the runner's dump or a checkpoint, the first (atom, component, end) with the CPU endpoint and the GPU endpoint; values-equal-but-digest-different is reported as a digest serialization fault
checker: independent: imports none of the trajectory runner, the one-step runner, pv_host, campaigns or GPU code; its own literal loop: F = forces(q); for each step: p = p + F; q = q + p * CDT; F = literal E2 forces(q); p = p + F (mpmath iv objects, frozen RwForce, K.domain, K.H, K.CDT, K.endpoints_key, K.decide); its own digest code; it starts N12 / N16 s500 from the FCC initial state and runs 600 steps itself
layouts: S10: every main trajectory with blocks 32 / 64 / 128 / 256: all per-step digests, checkpoints and the final outcome identical

performance.only_after: S10 and S100 checker EVIDENCE OK
performance.official_host: an available Vast RTX 3090 node (52763629 or 52763685 preferred); any change = amendment before the run; the EXPERIENCE_START_P_V2 Linux measurement shim in the launcher
performance.state_and_length: FCC_N initial state lifted at p, T = 100, the same for both paths

paths.CPU_W6_TRAJECTORY: E2 W6 (GPU_PAIR_VECTOR_V1 W6E2: unchanged E2 pair workers on CPUs 1-5, 0, canonical reduction in the main) forces + CPU kick / drift; initial F + 100 steps
paths.GPU_HYBRID_TRAJECTORY: GpuForceExecutor forces (block 32) + the same CPU kick / drift; initial F + 100 steps

performance.warm: context / model / buffers (GPU) or worker processes (W6) ready before the clock; timed = initial F + 100 steps; 5 repetitions, order alternating CPU -> GPU / GPU -> CPU; medians
performance.cold: a fresh subprocess per run: timed from before the executor (library load + CUDA context) / before the worker spawn to the end of step 100 (= context + allocation + model upload + initial F + trajectory); Python start-up and imports measured separately and excluded; 3 repetitions alternating
performance.breakdown: GPU: encode, H2D, pair/G/J kernels, atom reduction kernel, D2H, decode, CPU kicks, CPU drift, summed over the trajectory; W6: forces, CPU kicks, CPU drift; total / T also reported
performance.load: E2_PAIR_PARALLEL_V1 contamination snapshot and /proc/loadavg before each condition
performance.equality: each timed run's final (q, p, F) digest must equal the bundle's state 100
performance.classification_per_N: ratio = GPU warm median / W6 warm median; GPU_WIN <= 0.97, TIE between, CPU_WIN >= 1.03; cold ratios reported, not used for the class
performance.regions: per p: CPU confirmed / TIE / GPU confirmed at the measured N only; every unmeasured N UNKNOWN
performance.cost_estimate: W6 force 0.01-0.9 s x 101 per trajectory x 8 runs per condition -> about 20-25 min; GPU < 2 s per trajectory; checker S100 about 10 min (parallel trajectories); bundle build about 20 min on the desktop

fault_injections (all at step 3 unless s: 1 a wrong F: step 3 kicks with F_2 (the previous step's force) instead of F_3
2 F_s recomputed at every step instead of reused (endpoints stay identical by determinism; detected by the force evaluation count)
3 one force computation missing: F_4 := F_3
4 one step label skipped: no record 5, T - 1 physical steps
7 drift with the old momentum p_s instead of p_half
8 F_{s+1} computed at the old q_s
9 precision changed after step 5: GPU program at 128 for p = 109 (192 for p = 163), kicks at p
10 q_{s+1}: atom 0 x upper endpoint + one unit in the last place
13 continuing after a domain stop (F := 0, the trajectory goes on)
15 a block-size-dependent branch from step 2 (block != 32: F_{s+1} atom N-1 x upper + one ulp)
16 a GPU refusal (work limbs 8 at step 3) reported as a normal zero force

decision_rules_sealed.SHORT_TRAJ_FAIL: any endpoint / state digest / force digest mismatch, stop step / pair / kind mismatch, layout-dependent trajectory, silent overflow, force-reuse or persistence violation, or an undetected fault; performance is then not run
decision_rules_sealed.SHORT_TRAJ_EXACT_NO_GAIN: exact, but GPU_HYBRID is not GPU_WIN at any of N = 40, 64, 128 (p = 109)
decision_rules_sealed.SHORT_TRAJ_PROMISING: S10 exact, S100 exact, stop semantics exact, layout independent, GPU_WIN at N = 64 and N = 128 (p = 109), N = 40 ratio < 1.03, every timed final state equal to the CPU reference
decision_rules_sealed.SHORT_TRAJ_EXACT_MIXED: exact and none of the above
decision_rules_sealed.next_if_promising: GPU_LONG_TRAJECTORY_V1 (T = 1000 with the service precision, long-run domain stops, precision retry with the GPU)

not_in_scope: position / momentum update on the GPU
claims_forbidden: unmeasured N belong to the CPU or GPU region
a REFUSED run is a failure of physics
